title: Three simple problems that can tank your ads. Watch out and avoid the...
description: Three simple problems that can tank your ads. Watch out and avoid these 👀🙏
transcript: Three reasons ads don't work. First gonna be offer. They're not offering something that people want at the price point of which they're offering it. It's a super obvious thing, but if people can buy what you're selling on Amazon for 20% less, you're gonna struggle. Next is going to be ad creative. Like if a creative doesn't grab attention, doesn't interest people, no one's gonna take the action they want to take. No one's gonna look at it, no one's gonna do what you wanna do. Reason number three would be the advertiser not being able to just leave the thing alone. Like, oh, I spent $20, it didn't work. Panic, change everything. I did this. I introduced some new ads yesterday, but they didn't work well this morning. Therefore, I'm gonna turn them off, not give them time. I see people who get into it. They're just tinkering constantly, not letting the system learn, not accruing proper data, never giving themselves a chance to succeed.
